in_sanskrit.name: Shik
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Learning, Wisdom
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Shik एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Shik is a Hindi and Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'shiksha', which means 'learning'. It symbolizes intelligence, knowledge, and the pursuit of wisdom. It is an excellent name for a child destined to excel academically or in any intellectual pursuit.
